basic_details.job_title: TIFR Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Project Associate, Project Assistant Posts
basic_details.organization_name: Tata Institute of Fundamental Research (TIFR), Mumbai
basic_details.short_information: Tata Institute of Fundamental Research (TIFR), Mumbai has released Advertisement No. 2026/22, inviting applications for one post each of Project Associate and Project Assistant in the Department of Biological Sciences. Interested and eligible candidates with a BSc or MSc in Biological Sciences can apply online through the prescribed Google Form on or before 10 August 2026. Both positions are purely temporary, for a 10-month duration from 1 October 2026 to 31 July 2027.

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: BSc or MSc in Biological Sciences
post_wise_qualification.desirable: Experience in genotyping of mice and associated techniques, and tissue sectioning/histology will be advantageous

qualification.details: The selected Project Associate will work on projects involving microdissection, tissue culture, imaging, and histological analysis. The selected Project Assistant will provide genotyping support across multiple lab projects and will also perform histology and imaging.

selection_process: Screening of applications received Shortlisted candidates will be interviewed online

content_sections.heading: TIFR Vacancy 2026 – Post Details
content_sections.text: TIFR has announced a total of 2 vacancies across two posts in the Department of Biological Sciences, as shown below.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply – Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The selected Project Associate will work on projects involving microdissection, tissue culture, imaging, and histological analysis. The selected Project Assistant will provide genotyping support across multiple lab projects and will also perform histology and imaging.

rows.desirable_experience: Experience in imaging histological slides, microdissection of embryonic brain tissue, and tissue culture will be advantageous

rows.educational_qualification: BSc or MSc in Biological Sciences
rows.desirable_experience: Experience in genotyping of mice and associated techniques, and tissue sectioning/histology will be advantageous

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Project Associate: Preferably below 35 years Project Assistant: Not specified in the notification

content_sections.heading: Salary / Fellowship Structure
content_sections.text: Project Associate (NET-qualified): Rs. 31,000/- per month + HRA as per rules Project Associate (Non-NET-qualified): Rs. 25,000/- per month + HRA as per rules Project Assistant: Rs. 20,000/- per month + HRA as per rules

content_sections.heading: Nature and Period of Post
content_sections.text: Both appointments are temporary, for a period of 10 months (1 October 2026 to 31 July 2027), and are non-pensionable in nature.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Screening of applications received Shortlisted candidates will be interviewed online

content_sections.heading: Documents Required (CV Format)
content_sections.text: Candidates must attach a CV to the Google Form strictly in the format specified by TIFR. No additional information or pages beyond this format should be included. Personal information: Name, address, date of birth, nationality, contact number, email address Final marksheet and/or degree certificate of the eligible degree Academic history table covering: S.S.C., H.S.C., B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc., and M.Sc. - with University/Agency, Subjects, and Marks Obtained/Rank/Score for each Names, email addresses, and contact numbers of 2 referees

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TIFR Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official Google Form link: https://forms.gle/w2aNB5xHoDqaJWx59 Fill in all the required personal and academic information in the form Prepare your CV strictly as per the format specified in the notification Attach the CV to the Google Form Submit the application on or before 10 August 2026

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted only through the Google Form; no other mode of application is mentioned Do not include any information or pages in the CV beyond what is specified in the notification Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an online interview
